Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as sender.

Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, pair and trade addresses and otherwise calls condition.
Internal view sale-limit check reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary low-level delegatecall to a caller-supplied address.
Owner-only initialization of sale parameters with scaling arithmetic.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over recipients with unchecked balance arithmetic and duplicated Transfer events.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Internal pure CREATE2-style pair address computation using keccak256 and init code hash.
Caller address used for owner checks, allowance ownership, transfers and approve.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary attacker-controlled address executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
transferFrom calls ensure which enforces whitelist and sale-limit gating.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
delegate performs a low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend branches into duplicate Transfer emissions with halved values.
Delegatecalled external code regains control and can re-enter the contract with owner privileges.
msg.sender is supplied as the sender of transfer.
msg.sender is used as allowance owner and spender in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender determines the allowance deduction performed in the unchecked balance update.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1).
constructor computes totalSupply via _supply*(10**decimals).
transferFrom subtracts and adds balances without SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
transferFrom flows _value into the unchecked balance mutation.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
init sets _minSale with scaling multiplication.
init sets _maxSale with scaling multiplication.
init sets _saleNum.
batchSend mutates balanceOf mapping without SafeMath.
batchSend flows computed total into unchecked balance arithmetic.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress.
ensure reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass.
ensure reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
condition reads _saleNum.
condition reads _minSale.
condition reads _maxSale.
pairFor returns the pair address stored in ensure._UNI.
ensure._UNI is compared against _from to grant whitelist bypass.
batchSend.total computed as _value * _tos.length.
batchSend._to receives each loop recipient credited balance.
Attacker-controlled address a is the delegatecall target.
Attacker-controlled calldata b is the delegatecall payload.
transferFrom._value is applied to balances without overflow checks.
batchSend._value drives unchecked balance credits.
batchSend._value halved is emitted in the duplicated Transfer events.
